findings.title: Deleting cache does not refresh the connected-calendars cache status
findings.body: The delete mutation only calls the optional `onSuccess` callback. This component is also rendered with no guarantee that callback invalidates/refetches `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` (and it may be absent), unlike the disconnect mutation which explicitly invalidates its dependent queries. Consequently, after a successful deletion the UI continues to receive/render the old `cacheUpdatedAt`, still reporting cached data and offering the delete action until an unrelated refresh or reload. Invalidate or update the connectedCalendars query when the delete mutation settles successfully.

findings.title: Webhook setup script uses a macOS-only sed invocation
findings.body: `sed -i '' -E` is BSD/macOS syntax. On Linux, where GNU sed treats the empty string differently, this command fails after Tunnelmole has been started, so `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` is not updated and local webhook testing cannot work as advertised. Use a portable file-replacement approach or branch on the installed sed implementation.
